question: What initial visualization of the ka-syllable is prescribed at the beginning of practice?
premises: The ka-syllable is to be visualized first.
It is visualized upon the varāṭa.
inference: The practice begins with visualizing the ka-syllable on the varāṭa.
uncertainties: The precise referent of varāṭa in this ritual context is unclear.
plain_english: O Pārvatī, one should first visualize the ka-syllable upon the varāṭa.
